cp31:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Kaṇhadīpāyano isi paro paññāsavassāni anabhirato cariṃ ahaṃ. || ||
cp31:2.1: Na koci etaṃ jānāti anabhiratimanaṃ mamaṃ aham-pi kassaci nācikkhiṃ arati me carati mānase. || ||
cp31:3.1: Sabrahmacārī Maṇḍabyo sahāyo me mahā isi pubbakammasamāyutto sūlam-āropanaṃ labhī. || ||
cp31:4.1: Tam-ahaṃ upaṭṭhahitvāna ārogyam-anupāpayiṃ āpucchitvāna āgañchiṃ yaṃ mayhaṃ sakam-assamaṃ. || ||
cp31:5.1: Sahāyo brāhmaṇo mayhaṃ bhariyam-ādaya puttakaṃ tayo janā samāgantvā āgañchuṃ pāhunāgataṃ. || ||
cp31:6.1: Sammodamāno tehi saha nisinno saka-m-assame dārako vaṭṭam-anukkhipaṃ āsīvisam-akopayi. || ||
cp31:7.1: Tato so vaṭṭagataṃ maggaṃ anvesanto kumārako āsīvisassa hatthena uttamaṅgaṃ parāmasi. || ||
cp31:8.1: Tassa āmasane kuddho sappo visabala 'ssito kupito paramakopena aḍaṃsi dārakaṃ khaṇe. || ||
cp31:9.1: Saha daṭṭho āsīvisena dārako papati bhūmiyaṃ tenāhaṃ dukkhito āsiṃ mama vāhasi taṃ dukkhaṃ. || ||
cp31:10.1: Ty' āhaṃ assāsayitvāna dukkhite sokasallite paṭhamaṃ akāsiṃ kiriyaṃ aggaṃ saccaṃ var' uttamaṃ: || ||
cp31:11.1: Sattāham-evāhaṃ pasannacitto puñña 'tthiko acariṃ brahmacariyaṃ athāparaṃ yaṃ caritaṃ mama-yidaṃ vassāni paññāsasamādhikāni, || ||
cp31:12.1: Akāmo vā hi ahaṃ carāmi etena saccena suvatthi hotu hataṃ visaṃ jīvatu Yaññadatto. || ||
cp31:13.1: Saha sacce kate mayhaṃ visavegena vedhito abujjhitvāna vuṭṭhāsi arogo c' āsi māṇavo; saccena me samo natthi esā me saccapāramīti. || ||
